full_text:
Love potion

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadTrollPheromones | Source: The Bog Witch | Usage: Drinking | Buy: 110, Coins, for 5 | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Duration: 5m | Cooldown: 0s

Introduction. Love potion is a consumable item sold by The Bog Witch at 110 Coins for five potions.

Effect. Its consumption increases the spawn rate of Trolls (from 5% to 25%), increases the chance of starred Trolls and increases the maximum number of spawned Trolls (from 1 to 2). All Trolls are also automatically on alert.

Notes. • Trolls spawning within 2000 meters of the center of the world remain without star.
• Trolls spawning in event raids will have at least one star, even if within 2000 meters of the center of the world.
